evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Test solutions and models against requirements; Conduct assurance checks of implemented solutions
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Assurance-check and testing-against-requirements language provides rigour signal, balanced against a fast-paced consultancy-delivery framing ('recently formed and rapidly growing team', 'diverse and interesting responsibilities'), giving a mixed classification.
evidence.domain_risk: responsibility for managing and growing our portfolio of clients across Infrastructure and Real Estate sectors
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Consulting engagements support major client business decisions (project execution, model outputs) without explicit regulatory or financial-reporting language, keeping domain risk at moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Commission Directors; clients and their IT teams
evidence.data_team_maturity: join our specialized Turner & Townsend Digital Consulting team [...] this recently formed and rapidly growing team
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The team is explicitly described as 'recently formed and rapidly growing' within an established global consultancy, and the role names concrete tools already in use (DAX, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Power BI, Tableau), indicating a mid-stage function scaling within a mature parent organisation.
evidence.jd_authorship: Ability to programme in languages such as DAX, Python, VBA and SQL are essential [...] Experience in Azure platform (e.g. Data Factory, Databricks, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Blob Storage)
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Precise named tools (DAX, VBA, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Blob Storage) and concrete responsibilities (leading project teams, capturing modelling requirements, assurance checks) give a clear picture of the day-to-day work, indicating hiring-manager authorship.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Lead client engagements to capture data, analysis and modelling requirements
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role is explicitly client-facing consultancy work centred on winning and delivering for external clients (business generation, client pitches, client portfolio growth) — a commercial orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: Leading a project team consisting of analysts & consultants [...] Develop project execution plans and lead end-to-end project delivery with Commission Directors
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role leads teams and owns project execution planning (strategic) but also delivers scoped deliverables like reports, presentations, and running specific scenarios under Commission Directors (execution), giving a mixed autonomy profile.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention of AI tools for the candidate's own work or AI systems consuming the candidate's data output anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Test solutions and models against requirements; Conduct assurance checks of implemented solutions
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing and assurance checks are named as direct, owned responsibilities of the role using explicit action verbs, not just a tool mention.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed in delivery and consulting-capability terms (project execution, client engagement, dashboards) with no compliance, regulatory, or stakeholder-trust risk register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Develop end-to-end data processes and data models; Design data solutions in collaboration with clients and their IT teams
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Responsibilities emphasise designing and building new end-to-end data processes, models, and solutions for each client engagement rather than maintaining existing systems, indicating greenfield work.
evidence.urgency: Due to increasing demand for our consultancy services, we are seeking a Senior Consultant
